subject: McDonald Park Improvements Extension
overview: The commission approved a three-year extension for work at McDonald Park and discussed upcoming filings for a new pedestrian pathway under Route 28.

items.title: McDonald Park Order of Conditions Extension
items.summary: Approved a three-year extension of the Order of Conditions for McDonald Park (DEP file 215-0206) to allow for the completion of a playground and vegetation management. The Department of Conservation and Recreation confirmed that an updated vegetation management plan is being developed to address the loss of mature ash and cottonwood trees.

items.title: Administrative and Project Updates
items.summary: Staff announced a forthcoming filing for a pedestrian pathway under Route 28 and discussed board recruitment efforts and upcoming meeting schedules for January.
